scope: Rename a selected device-local editor workspace profile without replacing its saved appearance/dock contents or touching page data.
observed_gap: Saved workspace profiles could be saved, imported, exported, loaded and deleted, but their names could not be edited in place; users had to delete and recreate a profile to correct its label.

behavior.rename: The selected profile name is trimmed and limited to the existing 32-character input contract; case-insensitive duplicate names are rejected. Renaming preserves local ID, creation timestamp, appearance and dock snapshot.
behavior.selection: Selecting or importing a profile puts its current name in the edit field; a selected profile rename from another tab updates that field only when it still contains the previous profile name, preserving an in-progress user draft.
behavior.history: Rename is a workspace-only undo/redo operation. Undo and redo update both the selected profile label and its edit field. Browser storage failure keeps the change session-only and reports that limitation.
behavior.mobile: The native labeled button remains at least 44 CSS px high and wide and is available without hover.

contracts.save_publish: No Page Model save or publish request is sent; existing separate Save and Publish controls are unchanged.
contracts.profile_data: Existing allowlisted profile schema and device-local storage key are reused; no executable HTML/CSS/JS is introduced.
contracts.dependencies: No new dependency or copied third-party runtime code.

focused_browser.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='saved workspace profiles can be renamed|mobile workspace profile rename' tests/browser/editor-workspace-appearance.test.js

profile_lifecycle_recheck.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='saved workspace profiles can be renamed|mobile workspace profile rename|profile export/import uses|deleting a workspace profile' tests/browser/editor-workspace-appearance.test.js
